name: Nine-floor elevator: visible memory and interlocks

params.text: 1 · Pulse CALL1…9 then release. Each row stores one independent request; RESET clears all nine.
2 · Lowest pending floor wins through shared prefix OR gates. This is priority, not FIFO.
3 · Selected floor becomes binary bits0…3. DACvcc255 preserves the integer as a numeric floor target;0 means idle.
4 · External pulse opens/holds/clears service. Motion needs a pending request, closed doors, no pulse/fault and RUN.
